changes.title: Imported-history cache
changes.text: Recorded runs and imported rankings with matching filenames no longer reuse each other's cached records.

changes.title: Run-detail cleanup
changes.text: Removed an unused internal row-label helper while preserving the existing detail labels and actions.

changes.title: Merge cleanup
changes.text: Removed an unused counter from statistics merging without changing totals or their accuracy labels.

changes.title: Cache-source regression
changes.text: Added a real archive round-trip check for matching filenames, preserved raw logs and safe cache reloads.

changes.title: Verified batch evidence
changes.text: Recorded the preceding APK's delivery and the reproduced imported-history cache failure and fix.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I fixed an edge case where a history cache could display a recorded run in place of an imported ranking. The original logs remain untouched, and I removed two unused internal helpers.
